fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.skelet: Undead skeletal Seamen working under Dead Beard.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.glacia:
Oops! You've kinda done a racism!

I'm willing to forgive you because the rest of the mod is good but uhhh. Don't do it again <3.
A rare Zombie that appears deep in deserts. It's attacks cause ravenous hunger, and it unleashes a swarm of Scarabs upon the land.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.dead_b:
A dreadful pirate, hunting for more than just booty in undeath.

He has a reckless nature, being more than willing to detonate barrells of TNT above his head than to die and let a landlubber take his prize.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.undead:
Zombies that have taken up permanent residence in the dark and dank underground, where the sun is no longer a threat.

Eventually, all thing mine and craft.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.frostb: A gelid creature, filled with hate. It can freeze things it strikes, and when young, can explode into a local avalanche.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.hunter: This dog is always angry. It's got that dog in it. It's an annnnngryyyy dog.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.swampy: Mucky, goopy, decomposing zombies from swampy biomes. They float quickly, blind and poison on contact, and emenate lingering poison after death.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.zap.de: Zombie variant created by The Immortal during thunderstorms. They can multiply rapidly and draw shocks like a lightning rod, so be aware!
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.zombie: Undead zombie Seamen working under Dead Beard.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.burned:
Zombies who have wandered into lava or the Nether, and been warped into an unrecognizable flaming husk, with hatred for everything not on fire.

At low health, they get stronger, and they can be extinguished with water.
fieldguide.entity.rottencreatures.immort:
An exceptionally rare myth appearing only during thunderstorms, The Immortal is a force of nature. It can convert Zombies into Zaps, and channel lightning to it's will.

It is agile, strong and, in thunderstorms, nearly impossible to kill.

Nearly...
